profile.name: 横河7651单通道直流电源
profile.description: 横河7651是一台单通道可编程直流电源，用于实验中输出受控的直流电压或电流。根据驱动信息，该设备支持设置电压、电流、输出模式和输出状态，并在参数修改后通过触发使新设定生效，适合器件偏置、基础电学测试和台式自动化控制。
profile.description_en: The Yokogawa 7651 is a single-channel programmable DC power supply used in labs to source controlled DC voltage or current. Based on the driver evidence, it supports setting voltage, current, output mode, and output state, and requires a trigger after parameter changes for the new settings to take effect. It is suitable for device biasing, basic electrical testing, and bench automation.
